name: Solar Power and Battery SOC Bidirectional Eclipse Coupling
description: Average solar power and post-eclipse battery SOC are bidirectionally coupled through eclipse duration: longer eclipses simultaneously reduce solar power and deplete SOC. Identity-bidir UPR.
